name: The Kpalime Waterfall Trek
summary: Explore lush green rainforests and refreshing natural waterfalls around Kpalime.
description: Immerse yourself in the tropical nature of Kpalime. Visit Mount Agou, discover local artisan crafts, walk through cocoa and coffee plantations, and cool down under the stunning Cascade de Wome.

locations.description: Hiking to the highest point in Togo
Swimming and picnic at Wome Waterfall
Local artisan village and wood carving workshop

name: Lome Cultural & Beach Escape
summary: Discover the vibrant capital city, its bustling markets, historical sights, and sandy coast.
description: A rich weekend tour covering the Grand Marche, the famous Fetish Market in Akodessewa, historical monuments, and relaxing evenings at the tropical beaches of Lome.

name: Tamberma Valley Expedition
summary: A deep dive into the UNESCO World Heritage site of Koutammakou in Northern Togo.
description: Travel North to Kara and explore the fascinating fortified mud tower-houses (Takienta) of the Batammariba people. Experience authentic traditional living and stunning savannah landscapes.

locations.description: Tour of the Takienta mud castles
Safari viewing local fauna and flora

name: Togoville & Lake Togo Sailing
summary: Cross Lake Togo in a traditional pirogue to explore the historic town of Togoville.
description: A peaceful day trip starting at Agbodrafo, sailing across Lake Togo to Togoville. Visit the historical cathedral, traditional shrines, and learn about the treaty that gave Togo its name.

startLocation.address: Agbodrafo Boat Terminal, Lake Togo, Togo

locations.description: Visit to Togoville Cathedral and Vodou Shrines

name: Fazao-Malfakassa Wilderness
summary: Explore the rugged mountains and wild forest reserves in central Togo.
description: Hike through the Fazao-Malfakassa National Park, featuring dramatic mountain ridges, dense gallery forests, rivers, and wildlife spotting opportunities in a untouched conservation area.

name: Aledjo Fault & Plateaux Hike
summary: Discover the famous Failled d'Aledjo and mountain trails near Atakpame.
description: Journey through the scenic Plateaux region of Togo. Drive through the carved rock passage of Failled d'Aledjo, trek scenic highlands, and taste local coffee and fruit harvests.

locations.description: Scenic pass through the cleft mountain road
